name: Scalr
summary: Scalr runs Terraform plan and apply jobs as billable runs, with policy checks in each run. Its Business plan costs $0.99 per run, with a free tier of 50 runs a month, and Enterprise is priced by quote.

facts.text: An apply run covers plan, cost estimation, policy check and apply. A dry run covers plan, cost estimation and policy check, including pull request plans.
In state storage only mode, Terraform runs locally and Scalr stores the state, and those runs are not billed.
Unused runs in a prepaid plan do not roll over, and Scalr does not block a run when the quota is used up.
Scalr starts with five concurrent runs, and each self-hosted agent adds five more.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Start free button leads to sign-up.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Usage-based with volume discounts and annual plans. The page example shows 100 runs for $99 a month.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Request a quote or book a demo. No published price.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page uses dollar signs without naming a currency code.
Runs beyond the prepaid plan are billed at $0.99 each at the end of the subscription period.
